description: This file is a Python script that sets up and runs a conversational AI bot using various services such as Google STT, Gemini TTS, and Google LLM. It defines the pipeline for handling user input, speech-to-text, language modeling, text-to-speech, and transport communication, including event handlers for client connections and disconnections.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Represents the context for the language model, containing system messages and conversation history.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs the LLM context with user parameters for response aggregation.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the conversational pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates the pipeline execution with parameters and timeout settings.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Holds configuration parameters for pipeline behavior, such as metrics enabling.

classes.name: BaseTransport
classes.description: Abstract class for transport mechanisms handling client communication.

classes.name: RunnerArguments
classes.description: Contains command-line or configuration arguments for running the bot.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Sets up the speech services, constructs the processing pipeline, and manages client connection events to run the bot asynchronously.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main entry point that initializes the transport and starts the bot run cycle.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Pipecat's runner main function that starts the script execution.
